SELECT u.USER_NO, u.NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, u.INTRODUCE,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD b WHERE b.USER_NO = u.USER_NO AND b.BOARD_DELETE = 'N') as recipe_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCRAP s JOIN BOARD b ON s.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO WHERE b.USER_NO = u.USER_NO) as scrap_count FROM USER u WHERE u.WITHDRAW = 'N'
ORDER BY scrap_count DESC, recipe_count DESC
ORDER BY recipe_count DESC, scrap_count DESC
